entries.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
entries.snippet: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

entries.title: Trump-Xi summit: What wasn't said might matter the most
entries.snippet: The most revealing thing about the summit in Washington may be what the two leaders did not say - and what we still don't know.

entries.title: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
entries.snippet: The category-four storm is approaching the state of Baja California Sur, on Mexico's northern Pacific coast.

entries.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 28 dead
entries.snippet: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.

entries.title: Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections
entries.snippet: Aleksandar Vučić's administration has been dogged by prolonged protests over allegations of corruption.

entries.title: One dead as nor'easter storm pummels New York and New Jersey
entries.snippet: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia found themselves in the path of the powerful weather system.

entries.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow
entries.snippet: A slew of dissidents being released from long-term detention comes days after the nation's interim leader met the US president.

entries.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
entries.snippet: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

entries.title: Pope says 'scourge' of abuse must be rooted out as he visits Lourdes
entries.snippet: Pope Leo spoke to bishops before leading a service attended by thousands of worshippers in France.

entries.title: Two bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
entries.snippet: Rescuers are looking for at least 10 Nepalese people who were preparing to take climbers up the Himlung Himal peak.

entries.title: Switzerland rejects stricter interpretation of its neutrality
entries.snippet: The initiative would have prevented the nation from imposing sanctions unless approved by the UN.

entries.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
entries.snippet: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

entries.title: Killer Christa Pike to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too
entries.snippet: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.

entries.title: Woman charged with stealing from patients and staff at hospitals across Ontario
entries.snippet: The 34-year-old is under investigation for incidents that began in February 2024 up until as recently as last month.

entries.title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
entries.snippet: Germany's education minister has branded the ban on the small brass memorial plaques a "scandal".

entries.title: Why some Indian civil servants become heroes for doing their jobs
entries.snippet: In a system often marked by red tape and exhausting delays, officers seen to be following the rules get adulation.

entries.title: News media must stay relevant or 'society will struggle', says World News Day organiser
entries.snippet: World News Day aims to highlight the role of news providers in investigating and explaining important events.

entries.title: Before BTS and Blackpink, there was Big Bang: Now the Kings of K-pop are back
entries.snippet: Big Bang played London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, marking a long-awaited return for the group that helped build the blueprint for modern K-pop.

entries.title: Young people in China are fangirling over a professor who gets their anxiety
entries.snippet: China's economy and tech have developed at breakneck speed, but there is plenty worrying its Gen Z.

entries.title: The treasured 'eternal snow' on this tropical island is about to disappear forever
entries.snippet: Climate change is transforming Papua's snowy peaks, which hold scientific value and spiritual significance.

entries.title: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
entries.snippet: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

entries.title: Trump aims to leave a physical legacy in D.C., bulldozing norms along the way
entries.snippet: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.

entries.title: 5 men arrested over suspected attack at a U.S.-run air force base are British nationals
entries.snippet: Authorities have arrested five British nationals over a suspected attack at a U.S.-operated air force base in England. The men, all in their 20s from London, were detained Sunday.

entries.title: Welcome to the 'Wild West' of AI in schools: Research is scarce, but experiments abound
entries.snippet: Teachers are using AI to develop lesson plans, and in some districts, AI chatbots give students feedback on their work. Meanwhile, the research around how AI can help students is extremely limited.

entries.title: What to know about the $810 million in spending canceled by President Trump
entries.snippet: President Trump announced plans to cancel $810 million in Congressionally approved spending, a move that some in his own party are calling illegal.

entries.title: How to limit the rat numbers? Train the humans
entries.snippet: D.C.'s Rat Rangers take anyone who is interested on night time safaris through some of the Capitol's filthiest back alleys to learn the way of the rats, and to be better humans.

entries.title: 5 tips for parents worried about their kids' screen time and online safety
entries.snippet: Parental monitoring can help protect kids from the harms of social media and excess screen time. Screen time boundaries plus early and open conversations about online habits can make kids less vulnerable.

entries.title: Morning news brief
entries.snippet: President Trump has rejected Iran's latest proposal to end the war, five men were arrested near a U.K. air base for an alleged terror plot, Trump's fight with the press leaves his events uncovered.

entries.title: Mexico's Baja California braces for Hurricane Polo as Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii
entries.snippet: Hurricane Nolo edged further away from the Hawaiian Islands on Sunday as major Hurricane Polo bore down on Mexico's Baja California peninsula with a threat of storm surge, high winds and heavy rains.

entries.title: Eviction of 87-year-old sparks protests in Madrid over housing crisis
entries.snippet: Tens of thousands marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest Spain's housing crisis and the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, camping overnight in Madrid's historic Puerta del Sol plaza.

entries.title: Powerful nor'easter floods Northeast again, causing problems from New Jersey to New England
entries.snippet: Local officials in New Jersey and New York told residents that high tide late Monday could potentially bring more flooding.

entries.title: Civil rights enforcement cuts mean fewer staff, closed offices, longer waits for students with disabilities
entries.snippet: Filing a civil rights complaint with the Office of Civil Rights can be parents' last stop. Following cuts and restructuring, this federal office is no longer serving that same resource.

entries.title: 2 giant pandas arrive in Atlanta under a U.S.-China government agreement
entries.snippet: A new agreement between Zoo Atlanta and the China Wildlife Conservation Association makes Atlanta one of three zoos in the U.S. to house giant pandas, along with the San Diego Zoo and the Smithsonian's National Zoo in Washington, D.C.

entries.title: British PM Andy Burnham brings good vibes to his party's annual conference, but tough choices are coming
entries.snippet: The governing Labour Party opened its annual conference beside the River Mersey in Liverpool on Sunday, with Burnham pledging to turn the page on a decade of economic and political turmoil.

entries.title: Hurricane Nolo still threatens Hawaii as Mexico's Baja braces for major Hurricane Polo
entries.snippet: Nolo was expected to continue strengthening and turn toward the northwest by Sunday night, though the National Hurricane Center said the center of the storm would remain well south and southwest of the Hawaiian Islands.

entries.title: Supreme Court vote shadows Maine Sen. Susan Collins in her first race after abortion rights decision
entries.snippet: The Nov. 3 election will be the first time Collins is on the ballot since the Supreme Court's 2022 ruling that overturned Roe v. Wade, resulting in abortion being banned in much of the United States.

entries.title: UN speakers' go-to quotes: Ancient texts, modern greats and a little Talking Heads
entries.snippet: Speakers this week touched on homeland sayings, ancient texts, figures of moral authority and more — even a bit of Talking Heads (not TV pundits — the 1980s new wave band).

entries.title: Swiss reject tighter neutrality rules in referendum backed by right-wing populist party
entries.snippet: Final results from the Swiss government showed 70% of voters, and a majority in all 26 of the country's regions, rejected the plan.

entries.title: Pope blasts assisted dying as 'false compassion' at French shrine known for miraculous cures
entries.snippet: On the third day of his visit to France, Leo again waded into the end-of-life debate unfolding in his native U.S. and countries around the world.

entries.title: Eviction of 87-year-old sparks encampment protest in Madrid over housing crisis
entries.snippet: Tens of thousands marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest the eviction of María del Carmen Abascal from the apartment in the upscale Retiro neighborhood where she had lived for more than seven decades.

entries.title: Powerful nor'easter floods Northeast, leaves over 130,000 without power as high tides threaten coast
entries.snippet: The slow-moving storm, which killed a New York City housing authority worker when a tree fell Saturday, was expected to linger through Sunday with heavy rain, strong winds and dangerous surf from New Jersey to New England.

entries.title: 5 men arrested near UK air base used by U.S. in Iran war on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act
entries.snippet: Fairford has been used by American bombers for strictly limited strikes against Iran under an agreement with former British Prime Minister Keir Starmer, who voiced opposition to the war after it was launched by the U.S. and Israel on Feb. 28.

entries.title: House Democrats plan vast oversight of Trump administration. Impeachment is an option
entries.snippet: "There is a cost to the American people of the out-of-control corruption," said Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries of New York, who is in line to become House speaker if Democrats win control at the Capitol.

entries.title: Hurricane Nolo skirts Hawaii but could still unleash powerful winds and flash flooding
entries.snippet: While direct landfall by the storm's center was not expected, forecasters said it could cause life-threatening flooding and mudslides, with parts of the Big Island expected to see rainfall totals up to 20 inches.

entries.title: Kennedy Center put off planned repairs despite known structural issues, former employees allege
entries.snippet: The center's executive director and chief operating officer, Matt Floca, did not treat the roofing issues as priorities and in April halted a funded plan to address them, according to the letter Thursday signed by David Seide, a lawyer representing the anonymous whistleblowers.

entries.title: Russia's top diplomat rejects German calls to ease off its 'dangerous' escalation toward the country
entries.snippet: Lavrov was dismissive after the German and Russian foreign ministers met Saturday on the sidelines of the meeting, holding what's believed to be the first such tête-à-tête since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

entries.title: Bodies of 6 people, including 4 Americans, recovered from collapsed building in Athens
entries.snippet: The blast on Friday was believed to have been caused by a major gas leak, Athens Mayor Haris Doukas said. Neighboring buildings were damaged and evacuated.

entries.title: China and U.S. agree to establish AI safety channel and continue trade and military talks
entries.snippet: The summit produced no major breakthroughs, but analysts said the steps toward greater cooperation were important because they established working groups that could help prevent disputes from escalating.

entries.title: Trump administration uses rare authority to claw back nearly $1B in spending approved by Congress
entries.snippet: Most of the cuts are focused on Health and Human Services programs that serve refugees and unaccompanied minors accused of being in the country illegally.

entries.title: Pope Leo draws 800,000 people to central Paris for open-air Mass on iconic square
entries.snippet: The turnout testified to the church's lasting influence in France despite declining attendance and secularizing trends that have emptied churches across Europe.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Pope decries 'scourge' of sexual abuse during France visit
entries.snippet: French bishops took "courageous" steps when faced with "the painful scourge of abuse of minors," Pope Leo XIV told the high-ranking clerics before his scheduled meeting with survivors at the Catholic shrine of Lourdes.

entries.title: Turkey: Comedian on trial for 'insulting' Erdogan in show
entries.snippet: Deniz Goktas is accused of "insulting" President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, "praising" crime and criminals, and "inciting hatred and hostility" with jokes about Islam. Nominally, Turkey is a secular country with free speech.

entries.title: Diesel prices are surging. Ukraine is only part of the story
entries.snippet: Trucks, farms and industry are powered with diesel. Now prices are soaring due to refinery disruptions, supply shortages and geopolitical tensions. A potential US export ban could make Europe's diesel crunch even worse.

entries.title: Will Jürgen Klopp's charisma be enough for Germany?
entries.snippet: After defeat to Greece, Jürgen Klopp is confronted with the real challenge of his task as Germany head coach. Can his charisma alone push this group forward?

entries.title: Ireland beat Israel 3-0 in Nations League match overshadowed by political controversy
entries.snippet: Ireland easily beat Israel in a Nations League fixture that 24 hours earlier appeared in doubt. One Irish player pulled out of the match to express his opposition to Israel's actions in the Gaza Strip.

entries.title: Sweden faces political deadlock after election-winning center-left bloc fails to form government
entries.snippet: Swedish Social Democratic Party leader Magdalena Andersson has abandoned efforts to form a four-party government. Deep divisions within the election-winning bloc have left Sweden in political deadlock.

entries.title: India: LPU suspends classes after violent protests over alleged campus rape
entries.snippet: A university in Punjab has suspended classes after protests over a rumored sexual assault took a violent turn. Separately, the Supreme Court has taken suo motu cognizance of recent rape cases in Delhi. DW has more.

entries.title: Venezuelans demand opposition leader Machado's return
entries.snippet: Hundreds of people held rallies in Venezuela demanding the safe return of Maria Corina Machado, and fair elections.

entries.title: Germany news: Berlin's Left files complaint against Dobrindt
entries.snippet: Interior Minister Dobrindt could be in legal trouble after he seemed to accuse the Left's Elif Eralp of antisemitism. Domestic intelligence has warned on research cooperation with China. DW has more.

entries.title: What would Francis of Assisi make of his fame today?
entries.snippet: The Catholic saint renounced wealth and fame to become a mendicant friar. Yet throughout history, his teachings and life have inspired popes, Dante and even Mussolini.

entries.title: Ukraine, South Korea relations sour over North Korean POWs
entries.snippet: South Korea has accused Ukraine of breaching a confidentiality agreement over the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war — and of denying the deal's existence. Seoul has demanded an apology.

entries.title: Israel strips Dutch diplomats of status in West Bank
entries.snippet: The move by the Israeli Foreign Ministry is a response to Dutch sanctions targeting goods from illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The Dutch Foreign Ministry is yet to comment.

entries.title: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic announces resignation
entries.snippet: Aleksandar Vucic will now be running to be prime minister in the upcoming snap parliamentary elections slated for next month.

entries.title: Yemen: Houthis report deadly Saudi strikes on Taiz market
entries.snippet: The Houthi-run health ministry accused the Saudi Air Force of committing an "abominable crime," vowing to retaliate. The Houthis' account of the attack cannot be independently verified.

entries.title: Avalanche in Nepal leaves 2 dead, several missing
entries.snippet: An avalanche has struck the Himlung Himal base camp in Nepal after days of severe weather. Two guides are confirmed dead and at least 14 people remain missing in the remote region.

entries.title: UK: 5 arrested after 'major incident' near Fairford air base
entries.snippet: Scores of homes were evacuated in the UK town of Whelford, near an air base used by the US military, with bomb disposal teams checking "suspicious vehicles" at the scene. Police said five men had been arrested.

entries.title: Two people killed as bus crashes on way to Oktoberfest
entries.snippet: The bus was traveling from Italy to Munich, carrying 33 Filipino tourists who wanted to visit the famous beer festival. One of the dozens injured remains in life-threatening condition.

entries.title: European cities seek ways of boosting affordable housing
entries.snippet: In many major urban centers of Europe, the housing shortage has become an explosive social issue. DW looks into various models that have been put in place across the continent.

entries.title: Switzerland: Voters reject stricter view of neutrality
entries.snippet: Early projections show Swiss voters rejecting a stricter application of the country's vaunted neutrality. Swiss neutrality has been enshrined in the constitution since 1848.
